presets.name: Example 1: Procedural Spherical Harmonic Globe
presets.description: Solid 40mm Fibonacci sphere (30k pts) displaced by a synthetic spherical harmonic wave grid and coloured with the 'viridis' colormap. Ideal zero-download starter globe.

presets.name: Example 2: Hollow Globe with Equatorial Split & Magnets
presets.description: Hollow 40mm Earth globe (inner_ratio=0.55) with 40x ETOPO topography, 0.8mm coastline step, split into Northern and Southern hemispheres with 4 equatorial 5x2mm magnets.

presets.name: Example 3: High-Resolution Earth Hypsometric Relief
presets.description: Classic 50mm Earth physical relief globe using ETOPO 2022 at 40x vertical exaggeration, 0.8mm coastline step, and high-contrast 'terrain' bathymetric/topographic colouring.

presets.name: Example 4: Global Tectonic Plates, Trenches & Volcanoes
presets.description: Multi-layer vector + grid recipe combining ETOPO relief with raised tectonic plate boundaries (LineDisplacer), land polygons (PolygonColourer), and major hotspots/capitals (PointColourer).

presets.name: Example 5: 4-Filament Optical Mixing & OrcaSlicer 3MF Globe
presets.description: Multi-material 3D printable Earth globe using Kubelka-Munk 4-filament optical mixing (TERRAIN_4 spools: Deep Blue, Forest Green, Terracotta Brown, Pure White) with 8 discrete hypsometric elevation bands.

presets.name: Example 6A: Supercontinent Pangaea (Permian-Triassic 250 Ma)
presets.description: Deep-time Paleo-globe at 250 Ma (Permian-Triassic boundary) using Scotese 6-arc-minute PaleoDEM & PaleoAtlas texture, plate-reconstructed modern cities (London, New York, Sydney, Beijing), and N/S rotational poles.

presets.name: Example 6B: Cretaceous-Paleogene (K-Pg) Boundary (66 Ma, 4-Filament)
presets.description: End-Cretaceous world at 66 Ma rendered in 4-filament banded hypsometric mode with Chicxulub crater, London, New York, Sydney, and Beijing plate-reconstructed to their Late Cretaceous positions.

presets.name: Example 6C: Dawn of the Phanerozoic (Early Cambrian 540 Ma)
presets.description: Early Cambrian (540 Ma) paleogeographic reconstruction showing Gondwana assembly in the Southern Hemisphere and Panthalassic Ocean, with tracked continental cratons and polar markers.

presets.name: Example 7: Custom Typography, Gnomonic Symbols & Texture Filters
presets.description: Showcases ImageColourer with hillshade removal & bilateral filtering, spherical TextColourer labels ('PACIFIC OCEAN', 'PANGAEA'), gnomonic SymbolColourer stars/compasses, and PoleLabelColourer.

presets.name: Example 8: Equatorial Magnet Optimization (8 Magnets, Boss-Free)
presets.description: Demonstrates automated equatorial wall-thickness profiling and boss-free magnet placement (8x 5x2mm cylindrical magnets) on a thin-walled hollow globe with outer ETOPO relief and inner Moho cavity.

presets.name: Paper 01: S40RTS Core-Mantle Boundary (2850 km) Tomography Globe
presets.description: Recreates the dual-surface mantle tomography globe: outer shell displaced by ETOPO + S40RTS (2850 km LLSVPs), inner cavity displaced by CMB shear-wave velocity anomalies, coloured with 'RdBu_r'.

presets.name: Paper 02: Airy Isostasy & CRUST1.0 Moho Depth Globe
presets.description: Hollow isostatic Earth model where the outer surface displays 35x surface topography (ETOPO) while the inner cavity (inner_ratio=0.75) mirrors deep continental crustal roots (Himalayas, Andes) via Airy Moho calculation.

presets.name: Paper 03: EGM2008 Geoid Undulation & Topography Composite
presets.description: Weighted composite globe combining long-wavelength EGM2008 geoid height undulations (-106m Indian Ocean low to +85m New Guinea high, weighted 300x) with sharp surface topography and coastline steps.

presets.name: Paper 04A: PREM Earth Interior — Solid Inner Core (1221 km)
presets.description: Innermost nesting sphere of the scale-accurate Preliminary Reference Earth Model (PREM): solid 7.66 mm radius inner core coloured in metallic gold/amber.

presets.name: Paper 04B: PREM Earth Interior — Liquid Outer Core Shell (3480 km)
presets.description: Middle nesting shell of the PREM Earth Interior set: 21.85 mm outer radius, inner_ratio=0.36 (housing the Inner Core), with 4x 3x1.5mm equatorial magnets and molten orange-red colouring.

presets.name: Paper 04C: PREM Earth Interior — Mantle & Crust Outer Shell (6371 km)
presets.description: Outermost nesting shell of the PREM Earth Interior set: 40.0 mm outer radius with 45x ETOPO relief, inner_ratio=0.555 (CMB cavity housing the Outer Core), and 6x 5x2mm equatorial magnets.

presets.name: Paper 05: Residual Dynamic Topography (Hoggard et al. 2016)
presets.description: Visualizes mantle-convection-driven surface deflections (+/- 2 km residual dynamic topography) superimposed with continental outlines and a diverging 'coolwarm' colormap.

presets.name: Paper 06A: Planetary Comparison — Earth (R=40.0 mm, 50x Exagg)
presets.description: Reference planet in the true-to-scale Terrestrial Planetary Topography suite: 40.0 mm radius Earth with 50x vertical exaggeration and full bathymetric/topographic relief.

presets.name: Paper 06B: Planetary Comparison — Mars MOLA (R=21.3 mm, 20x Exagg)
presets.description: Scale-accurate Mars globe (53.2% of Earth's radius = 21.3 mm) using MGS MOLA topography at 20x vertical exaggeration, showcasing Olympus Mons (+21.2 km), Tharsis, Valles Marineris, and Hellas Basin.

presets.name: Paper 06C: Planetary Comparison — The Moon LOLA (R=10.9 mm, 14x Exagg)
presets.description: Scale-accurate Lunar globe (27.3% of Earth's radius = 10.9 mm) using LRO LOLA elevation data at 14x vertical exaggeration, highlighting the South Pole-Aitken Basin and lunar maria.

presets.name: Paper 06D: Planetary Comparison — Venus Magellan (R=38.0 mm, 40x Exagg)
presets.description: Scale-accurate Venusian globe (95.0% of Earth's radius = 38.0 mm) using Magellan radar altimetry at 40x vertical exaggeration, featuring Maxwell Montes, Ishtar Terra, and Aphrodite Terra.

presets.name: Paper 06E: Planetary Comparison — Mercury MESSENGER (R=15.3 mm, 25x Exagg)
presets.description: Scale-accurate Hermean globe (38.3% of Earth's radius = 15.3 mm) using MESSENGER MLA/stereo topography at 25x exaggeration, showing Caloris Basin and Borealis Planitia.

presets.name: Paper 07A: Seismic Matryoshka — Shell 1: Upper Mantle 50 km (Olivine)
presets.description: Outermost shell (R=40.0 mm, inner_ratio=0.72) of the 4-layer Seismic Matryoshka nesting set: S40RTS 50 km depth slice (olivine lithosphere/asthenosphere) coloured in 'YlGn' with 5x2mm magnets.

presets.name: Paper 07B: Seismic Matryoshka — Shell 2: Transition Zone 410 km (Wadsleyite)
presets.description: Second shell (R=28.0 mm, inner_ratio=0.68) of the Seismic Matryoshka set: S40RTS 410 km phase-transition depth slice coloured in 'GnBu' with 4x1.5mm equatorial magnets.

presets.name: Paper 07C: Seismic Matryoshka — Shell 3: Discontinuity 660 km (Ringwoodite)
presets.description: Third shell (R=18.5 mm, inner_ratio=0.65) of the Seismic Matryoshka set: S40RTS 660 km discontinuity depth slice showing stagnating subducted slabs, coloured in 'Blues' with 3x1.5mm magnets.

presets.name: Paper 07D: Seismic Matryoshka — Core 4: CMB 2850 km (Bridgmanite / Post-Perovskite)
presets.description: Innermost core sphere (R=11.5 mm, solid) of the Seismic Matryoshka set: S40RTS 2850 km Core-Mantle Boundary slice highlighting the African and Pacific LLSVP superplumes in 'YlOrBr'.

presets.name: Paper 08: Lithosphere-Asthenosphere Boundary (LAB) & Cratonic Keels
presets.description: Dual-surface lithospheric thickness globe: outer surface shows 35x ETOPO relief while the inner cavity (inner_ratio=0.72) is displaced by the LITHO1.0 / Priestley LAB depth showing >250 km Archean cratonic keels.
